author: resepignev
body:
Heey resepignev here,

Well as you can see in the title, I just wanted to know your opinion on a DTM map called Travincal DTM. It would be a indoor map with more than one layer and one or two monuments.

I'm asking cuz I'm not sure if you want something like this and if this is too much Travincal xD

So plz post your thoughts, constructive critism and/or suggestions :D

Thanks for your time!

EDIT: I don't even know why I want to make a Travincal map for every Gamemode, maybe I'm on a Travincal-trip xD I also wanted to make a indoor DTM map and it turned into a Nexus map called Travincal :D
